criteria.name: Core Web Vitals meet defined targets
WCAG 2.2 AA checks pass
evidence: Pa11y and Lighthouse accessibility gates are configured; WCAG 2.2 manual review remains.

criteria.name: Full mobile journey works
Student resumes the last lesson
evidence: Progress schema stores last_lesson; enrolled lesson resume journey still requires staging proof.

criteria.name: Slow and interrupted connections recover gracefully
evidence: Branded connection recovery and safe form drafts are implemented; mobile network testing remains.

criteria.name: Course search returns useful results
evidence: Topic, title, curriculum and level filtering is implemented; representative search relevance sign-off remains.

criteria.name: Checkout communicates every state
evidence: Pending, cancelled and failed payment pages are implemented; paid and delayed confirmation journey requires staging proof.

criteria.name: Delayed PayFast ITN is handled correctly
evidence: Payment reconciliation is idempotent and tested; delayed sandbox ITN evidence remains.

criteria.name: Students cannot access another student's data
evidence: Supabase profile RLS and Django permission tests exist; full cross-student enrolment, progress and order proof remains.

criteria.name: Protected content is never publicly cached
Automated backups restore successfully
evidence: Encrypted backup and weekly isolated restore-test services are implemented; successful staging restore evidence remains.

criteria.name: Load tests meet agreed thresholds
evidence: Normal, peak, spike and degraded Locust gates are implemented; staging results remain.

criteria.name: Lighthouse CI passes
No critical security vulnerabilities remain
evidence: Python and Node critical dependency audits pass locally; container and repository scans remain GitHub evidence.

criteria.name: Transactional email passes SPF, DKIM and DMARC
Errors are useful without technical disclosure
evidence: Branded safe error pages and correlation-reference tests pass; staging response review remains.

criteria.name: Monitoring captures failures without personal data
evidence: Prometheus/Grafana rules avoid personal labels; staging failure capture and dashboard review remain.

criteria.name: Essential navigation and forms work without JavaScript
Monitoring and administration outages do not stop students
evidence: Services are not application dependencies and a controlled outage test exists; staging result remains.

criteria.name: Desktop, Android and iPhone experience is professional
